ingredientSections.heading: Edamame Hummus
items: 1 tsp each of sesame & sunflower oil

methodSections.heading: Turmeric Dressing
steps: Soak the cashews in water for 1 hour and then drain.
Place all ingredients in a blender and mix at a high speed until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Roasted Squash
steps: Peel and cube the squash into 1cm (½in) pieces.
Toss the cubes in oil, salt and pepper, spread out evenly on an oven dish and roast at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes, or until tender and lightly caramelized.

methodSections.heading: Edamame Hummus
steps: Pulse all ingredients in a food processor until edamame beans are broken down and all ingredients are well mixed.

methodSections.heading: Bowl Assembly
steps: Assemble each serving in a large bowl starting with the rice on one half and greens on the other. Discard the tempeh marinade.
Arrange the cabbage, squash, sliced cucumbers and marinated tempeh on top of the rice.
Top with the dressing, sprinkle with black sesame seeds and finish with a generous dollop of edamame hummus.

methodSections.heading: Pickled Cabbage
steps: Purée the ginger and water in a high-powered blender. Slice or shred the cabbage finely and place in a large bowl.
Heat all the ingredients, except the cabbage, until the sugar and salt dissolve.
Pour the liquid over cabbage. Keep all of the cabbage submerged with a small plate or similar and allow to cool for 1-2 hours. Drain the liquid from the cabbage before serving.

methodSections.heading: Marinated Tempeh
steps: Cut tempeh into 1cm (½in) cubes and simmer in water for 15-20 minutes, or until it becomes tender.
While the tempeh is cooking, add all the other ingredients to a bowl and stir.
When cooked, drain the tempeh and transfer to the mixing bowl while still hot and gently mix with the marinade. Can be served hot or cold.
